principle.name: PHASE_SAFE_DEFERRED_COMMIT
principle.new_temporal_problem: An external commit request arrives at an unsafe phase of a repeating anticipation loop. The request must become durable immediately without forcing an arbitrary-pose launch or resetting the loop.
principle.pocket_rule: LATCH THE INTENT. KEEP THE PHASE. EXIT ONLY WHERE THE LOOP EARNS IT.
principle.rule: INTENT_ARRIVAL != TRANSITION_TIME. A request may latch now, while authority transfers only at a declared EXIT_WINDOW on the owning loop clock.
